explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/614: f(n,k) is the minimal number of edges of an n-vertex graph in which every (k+2)-set induces a subgraph of maximum degree ≥ k; determine f(n,k). The answer is a two-variable function, and the statement asserts it is the least such edge count for all n, k. The set is nonempty because K_n works, and it is vacuous when n < k + 2. Faithful.
